title: Gesticulate
summary: GESTIC'ULATE, verb intransitive [Latin gesticulor, from gestum, gero, to bear or carry, or gestio.] To make gestures or motions, as in speaking; to use postures. GESTIC'ULATE, verb transitive To imita

inlines.v: GESTIC'ULATE, verb intransitive [Latin gesticulor, from gestum, gero, to bear or carry, or gestio.] To make gestures or motions, as in speaking; to use postures. GESTIC'ULATE, verb transitive To imitate; to act.
